# Olfia Rachmi W

> AI & Computer Vision Engineer based in Bali, open to remote or hybrid roles. Builds computer vision models and the web apps that put them to work.

Site: https://olfiarach.vercel.app

## About
- 3+ years shipping React and Next.js apps, now working in machine learning: curates data, trains and tunes models, wraps them in apps people can use.
- Coding instructor since 2022 (Timedoor Academy); 98% of students finish their final project.

## Skills
- AI & Vision: Python, PyTorch, YOLOv8, OpenCV, Roboflow
- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Webflow
- Backend & Data: FastAPI, Node.js, Firebase, Realm, Google Maps API

## Featured project: TemanNetra
- Real-time Indonesian Rupiah banknote detector for visually impaired micro-merchants.
- YOLOv8 model with mAP@50 above 90%, served via FastAPI in under 150 ms.
- Code: https://github.com/olfiarach/TemanNetra
- Live app: https://olfiarach.github.io/TemanNetra/
